requirement_name: Observed detection arrived within the governed latency budget
failure_title: Observed detection exceeded the governed latency budget
limitations_text: Observed sensor timing is derived from one replayed track and should be corroborated with preserved ingest metadata.
lesson_statement: Keep detection and publish clocks aligned before report release.

requirement_name: Observed track continuity remained within the governed floor
failure_title: Observed track continuity dropped below the governed floor
limitations_text: Continuity is averaged across two observation points in this compact replay and does not represent throughput stress.
lesson_statement: Keep observation gaps visible in the governed quality rollup.

requirement_name: Shared track publication met the governed publish budget
failure_title: Shared track publication exceeded the governed latency budget
limitations_text: Observed command timings come from one replay lane and should be corroborated with preserved broker metadata.
lesson_statement: Keep publish and receive clocks on the same governed offset.

requirement_name: Track correlation completed within the governed window
failure_title: Correlation window exceeded the governed target
limitations_text: The synthetic scenario uses one track and one relay path so multi-track contention is intentionally out of scope.
lesson_statement: Escalate relay delay when correlation exceeds the agreed window.

requirement_name: Polled readiness coverage met the governed minimum
failure_title: Polled readiness coverage fell below the governed target
limitations_text: Only explicit polled participants contribute to the governed readiness ratio in this compact dataset.
lesson_statement: Poll the backup participant earlier and pair sustainment context with readiness review.

requirement_name: Critical maintenance actions were closed before the governed report window
failure_title: Critical maintenance actions remained open during the governed report window
limitations_text: The synthetic sustainment lane models queue depth and action state rather than physical repair duration.
lesson_statement: Close queued work orders or narrow the objective claim before final reporting.
